links.outcome: Consistency of LLM answers across three repeated runs of the same question
links.effect: ChatGPT and Perplexity provided consistent answers to all questions; all three models performed well on reliability.
links.quote: All three models performed well in terms of reliability, with ChatGPT and Perplexity providing consistent answers to all questions.

links.outcome: Clinical appropriateness of LLM answers with WA-specific terminology versus general questions
links.effect: Appropriate answers: ChatGPT 97%, Perplexity 90%, Gemini 87%. Inappropriate responses were more common with WA-specific terminology, particularly for Perplexity and Gemini.
links.quote: Inappropriate responses were more common when questions included WA-specific terminology, particularly for Perplexity and Gemini.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, safety, and local clinical appropriateness of multiple consumer LLMs answering breast cancer queries graded by expert clinicians without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
